three_treatments.mitigating_note: because HN-GFN's HV ref point is (0,0), a zero-scored invalid molecule contributes nothing to its HV; the distortion falls on diversity, top-K and the budget denominator rather than on HV

cost_of_running_compose_alone.compute: ~58 min per source on 8 CPUs for all five arms; ~12 core-hours for a 12-source panel; CPU-only; compute is NOT the obstacle
cost_of_running_compose_alone.oracle_work: ~270,000 unique evaluations per source on the primary arm; ~3.2M across 12 sources
cost_of_running_compose_alone.actual_blocker: COMPOSE cannot call tdc.Oracle. Installing PyTDC is barred and TDC's sklearn-dependent model selection is the exact drift artifacts/oracles/drd2_svm_v1 exists to prevent. Needs a version-independent extraction of two RandomForests (97MB, 38MB), hash-bound with a parity panel: 1-2 days engineering, zero GPU. NOT AUTHORIZED, NOT STARTED, and should not be built to serve this comparison since dimensions 1 and 2 fail regardless.
cost_of_running_compose_alone.new_constraint: docs/ORACLE_BATCH_INVARIANCE_DEFECT.md records COMPOSE DRD2 batch-size dependence at 1.82e-14 (drd2_oracle.py:213), the magnitude that flips an argmax tie over a ~586-wide fiber; main-lane Decision 1 pins all claim-bearing decision code to the legacy B=1 path. A GSK3b/JNK3 extraction would inherit the same rule, and RandomForest predict_proba (a mean over per-tree probabilities) has the same accumulation-order exposure. Another reason not to build it for this comparison.
